newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline slips $1 with crude, faltering US.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline slips $1 with crude, faltering US.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices slipped $1 a tonne on Thursday morning, tracking weaker crude oil and extending similar losses seen on Wednesday.
Premium barges traded at $182 and $183.50 fob ARA and at $184 fob AR while regular refinery product traded at $178.75 fob.

Swaps were dragged lower by Brent while crack spreads holding broadly steady. August traded early at $185.75 and later at $184.25 for July. Towards noon August was valued at $184.75 and September $183.25.
